name: cut-dancers
eval: bend.set('redwoods', { hour: 19.4, dayGoes: false }); bend.set('camera', { followDist: 3.6, followFov: 44, followPitch: 0.1, followSwing: 0 }); bend.wake(); bend.place(0,-0.6,0,Math.PI/2); bend.place(1,0.6,0,-Math.PI/2); await bend.step(200); bend.camera({ yaw: 0.3 }); await bend.step(30); await bend.world('redwoods'); for (const d of bend.show.dancers) bend.gates.place(d, 'redwoods'); bend.place(0,-4.6,3.4,Math.PI/2); bend.place(1,-3.4,3.4,-Math.PI/2);
